stories.title: Pitcher, surgery pioneer Tommy John dies at 83
stories.summary: Former major league pitcher Tommy John, the namesake behind the pioneering elbow surgery that prolonged his career for 14 more years, died at the age of 83.

stories.title: Mariota has MCL sprain; Week 1 return expected
stories.summary: Commanders quarterback Marcus Mariota suffered a sprained right knee and will miss the rest of the preseason, but he is expected to be ready for the regular-season opener.

stories.title: Ronaldo will 'probably' retire after this season
stories.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has given his clearest indication yet that he could retire from football at the end of the current season, saying it is "probably my last year."

stories.title: McVay: No 'invisible deadline' on Donald decision
stories.summary: Rams coach Sean McVay says he won't put an "invisible deadline" on Aaron Donald to come out of retirement but added that he hopes the former star defensive tackle makes a decision "sooner than later."

stories.title: Pirates skip Skenes start to rest struggling ace
stories.summary: The Pirates will move Paul Skenes' next scheduled start back three days, giving the struggling ace extra rest amid the worst stretch of his major league career.
